summary: Protara Therapeutics filed a prospectus supplement (Rule 424(b)(5)) for an at-the-market (ATM) common stock offering of up to $100 million under an existing shelf registration. The securities are sold through TD Cowen as sales agent, with compensation of up to 3.0% of gross proceeds. The filing is a routine shelf takedown for capital raising, not a special situation; no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, restructuring, or other special event is involved. There is no deal to analyze.
